items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: Louis wrote to me and told me he was going to leave Fletcher.

ctx.x: What was the first record session in Chicago?

Hot Five. Hot Five. Hot Five. Louis wrote to me and told me he was going to leave Fletcher. He heard I was coming to Chicago, what I record with him, you know. Then I worked at Dreamland with Louis after that, you see. After the... Dutry got well and I was waiting for him.
I asked Ed one question. Why he didn't have a band of his own in Chicago. Yeah. You know the answer I got? He was fed up with the responsibilities. Yeah.
